text: Rafael flies to Lisbon May 14, back the 28th. Twelve hour layover in Newark on the way, poor guy. Text him the day before to wish him a good trip.
kenji vegetarian now. not vegan, still eats eggs. also off caffeine since sept
Hana's cat Miso has a lump on her side, vet is looking at it Thursday. Hana sounded really worn down. Need to check in with her the next day.
Anan and Jada just back from Bali, both totally jetlagged. They brought me a sarong lol
Katarzyna mentioned her mum is gluten free, coeliac actually, so for the dinner on June 3rd make sure the dessert is safe.
So, um, Kiara got a puppy. A beagle called Biscuit. She's picking him up on Saturday and she's already bought like four beds for him.
pick up passport photos, renew before 7/2
Naledi's brother Andile moves to Toronto next month. Their mum is not coping well with it apparently.
Imani hates coriander. Like properly hates it. Note for the taco night.
Ricardo & Beatriz's anniversary trip to Kyoto is off, his dad's in hospital. Ask Ricardo how his dad is doing later this week
Yosef said Shabbat dinner at theirs Friday, kosher obviously, and he likes a decent Rioja if I'm bringing wine.
Dafydd's spaniel Bryn turns 10 on August 9. He's doing a cake for the dog. Absolute legend.

Long one. Talked to Hoang for ages after work. Her sister Kiara is getting married in Hanoi in December and the whole family is flying out, which means a 14 hour flight with two toddlers, and she's dreading it. She asked if I had tips for long-haul with kids. She's also trying to figure out who'll look after their parrot while they're gone, three weeks. I said I'd ask around. Remind me to send her that blog post about flying with toddlers before she books.
varun - lactose intolerant, loves spicy food, drinks only diet coke. birthday 11/22
Michael's flight got cancelled so he's not coming to the reunion after all.
Anjali passed her driving test!! First try. Send her congrats tonight
Alana's dog had surgery on his leg yesterday, she's sleeping on the sofa next to him. Call her tomorrow.
Groceries: oat milk, nuts for the trip, sunscreen. Vet for Pepper at 4 on Oct 30.
Connor's going to Japan in the spring with his girlfriend Erin, three weeks, Tokyo then Osaka then Hiroshima. He's been learning Japanese on Duolingo for like a year.
Matteo doesn't drink anymore. Six months sober he said. Get the alcohol-free stuff for the barbecue.
Deepa interview with the airline March 3, cabin crew. She's super nervous. Text her good luck that morning and ask how it went afterwards.
mihai's wife expecting, due early feb. he wants a cot but they've no space in the flat lol
Blessing — allergic to shellfish. carries an epipen.
Callum and his partner Dana are doing Route 66 next summer, renting a convertible. Dana's planning the whole thing on a spreadsheet
Esther's grandad passed away last week. Funeral is Tuesday. I should send flowers the day before, and maybe pop round a week after when things calm down.

Kai said his tortoise Gerald is 40 years old. Older than him! Inherited from his granddad when he died a few years back. Gerald hibernates in a box in the garage from November, and Kai's a bit worried this year because the vet said he's underweight going in. He's got a check-up booked for Oct 28, and if it's not good they'll keep him awake through winter. Kai clearly adores him, talks about him like a family member.
Alice wants one of those fancy pour-over coffee kits for Christmas, she kept pointing at it in the shop window.
Rafael Santos aka Rafa is back from Brazil, did a week in Salvador with his cousins. Loved the food, came back three kilos heavier he says.
Remember to book the cattery for Smudge before the Rome trip, flights leave June 12th.
Kenji's wife Hana is starting a new job at the vet clinic on Monday. She's a bit anxious about it. Ask her how the first day went the next day.
Anan just found out he's allergic to cats. Which is unfortunate because his girlfriend has two. They're figuring it out

ok voice note. Jada's mum is turning 60 on April 18 and they're throwing a surprise party at a Jamaican restaurant, the one on the high street. Jada wants everyone there by seven. Her mum loves rum punch, so maybe bring a bottle of something nice. Also, I need to RSVP by the end of the week.
Kat's — Katarzyna's — dog ran off in the park on Sunday, found him two hours later in someone's garden. She's still shaken.
Kiara's leaving for Ghana on 9/14, a month volunteering. Her boss let her take unpaid leave.
Naledi wants to try going plant-based in January. Her husband is not on board haha
Andile mentioned his daughter's school trip to Paris got cancelled, now they're doing a trip to the zoo instead.
Imani nervous about her first solo trip, Morocco, Nov 2nd. I said I'd give her my Marrakech recommendations. Message her the list before she goes.

Ricardo is a total foodie, does a supper club once a month out of his flat, eight people, five courses. Next one is the 25th, Peruvian theme, and I'm going. He's been practising ceviche all week and asked if anyone had allergies. Told him about my nut thing. He also mentioned he's thinking of quitting his office job to cook full time but his wife Beatriz wants him to wait until they've paid off the car.
Beatriz's son Kai has a peanut allergy, quite severe. Worth remembering if we have them round.
Yosef's parakeet died yesterday. He had it for 15 years. He's pretty cut up about it. Maybe check in with him at the weekend.
dafydd - welsh, lives in cardiff, works in a brewery. loves craft beer obviously. hates tea which is weird
Need to buy a new suitcase before October. The old one's wheel snapped on the last trip.
Hoang's back from Hanoi. Wedding was gorgeous apparently. Ask to see photos when we meet for lunch on Thursday.
Varun's cat got diagnosed with kidney disease. He's changing her diet to some special prescription food. He sounded really low.
Michael and Anjali are celebrating 10 years married on July 4th, going to a cabin in the mountains.
Alana's moving to Barcelona in the new year with her girlfriend. She's already got a job lined up teaching English. I should call her before she goes.

Connor's sister Alice just had a baby girl, Rosa, 7lb 2oz, born Tuesday night after a long labour. Connor drove down the next morning and says Alice is exhausted but fine. He's an uncle for the first time and won't stop sending photos. Their mum is flying back from Spain on Friday to help out. Should get something small for the baby, maybe one of those personalised blankets, and send it once they're home from hospital.

Quick recap from coffee with Matteo. He's planning a three-week trip to Patagonia starting Jan 8, hiking mostly. Flying via Madrid, then Santiago, then a little plane down to Punta Arenas. His boss signed it off finally. He's also been getting into fermentation, kombucha and kimchi, and gave me a jar. He wants a proper dehydrator for his birthday, which is Dec 2nd. Don't forget to grab one before then.
erin - pescatarian. allergic to kiwi of all things
Deepa said her dad's knee surgery is on the 19th, she's taking the week after off to look after him.
Mihai got the job at the travel agency! Starts May 1st. He's thrilled.
Blessing's daughter graduates from nursing school on June 7. The family is flying in from Lagos the day before. She asked if I'd come. Remind me to get a card.
Callum's been feeling really low since the breakup. Barely eating. Try to get him out for a curry next week

Dana's birthday is coming up, Sept 30th. She's mentioned wanting a new hammock for the garden, twice now, so that's a pretty clear hint. Callum's organising drinks at the pub the Saturday after and wants us all to chip in. Need to transfer him twenty quid by Friday.

Esther and her husband are doing a cruise around the Greek islands, leaving on the 12th, ten nights. It's their first proper holiday since the kids were born. She's worried about getting seasick though, she was ill on a ferry to France once and never forgot it. I told her about the wristbands. Her husband Yosef is just excited about the food on board, apparently there are six restaurants. Ask her how it went when they're back, and whether the wristbands worked.
Kai's new puppy is a husky called Luna. He's collecting her on 5/20 and taking the week after off work to settle her in.

Alice can't do dairy or eggs anymore, doctor's orders. Something about her skin flaring up, they're testing for allergies on Nov 4. She's gutted, she was a big baker, used to do a cake every Sunday. Now she's experimenting with aquafaba and oat butter and says the results are mixed. She's bringing a vegan brownie to book club next week to test on us. Honestly I admire the commitment.
Rafael's dad is in hospital again, the heart thing. He's flying to São Paulo tomorrow night. I need to text him the morning after he lands.
Book the dentist. Also order more dog food, we're nearly out.
Hana's mum is visiting from Osaka for two weeks starting April 3rd. Hana's stressed about cooking for her because she's super picky, only eats Japanese food.
